title: Marine Retreat Chosin Reservoir; C-119 Airdrop; Korean War, 12/1950
summary: National Archives description "Summary: Scene of some of the 15,000 marines who broke out of the Hagaru-ri trap at Chosin Reservoir as they arrive on foot and in vehicles. The first shot shows the marines plodding along the strip. A Korean woman with child on her back stands in right fg. Cpl A W Rasmussen and Cpl J Scott at water-cooled MG looking through binocs, pointing, talking. Men around fire
